footer_tagline: Ulwazi oluhlangahlangeneko lokulwisana nobudlwangudlwangu obususelwa ebulilini kanye nokusekelwa, okwakhelwe abafazi neentombazana zeSewula Afrika.
footer_bottom: SafeHaven · Yakhelwe abafazi neentombazana zeSewula Afrika
hero_desc: I-SafeHaven ihlanganisa iindawo zokuphephela, iseluleko lomthetho, kanye nomuntu ongakhuluma naye endaweni yinye, eyakhelwe iSewula Afrika, ngeelimi ozikhulumako.
how_1_text: Funa iindawo zokuphephela, iikliniki, namaofisi wosizo lomthetho ngesifundazwe bewubone khokho okunikelwa ngamunye ngaphambi kokobana uyekhona.
how_2_text: Iinqophiso ezicace bunono zichaza imiyalo yokuphephela, ukubika ubudlwangudlwangu, nokuthi umthetho weSewula Afrika ukuvumelani wenze.
how_3_text: Koke okusesiteni le kungavalwa msinyana nge-Quick Exit, begodu akukho lutho lapha egcinwako namkha elandelelwako.
resource_rights_sub: Inqophiso yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo sokufaka isibawo, mahhala
resource_support_sub: Iinamba zosizo kanye namasekelo weluleko, nanini ngelanga
cta_desc: Koke okuku-SafeHaven kumahhala, kuyimfihlo, begodu kwakhelwe ukusebenza ngitjho nangokuxhumana okumnyama.
